doc.title: Dave Valentin interviewed by Monk Rowe, Scottsdale, Arizona, April 15, 2000

title: Working with Concord and musician-run labels
summary: He likes Concord's John Burke, a musician like Larry Rosen and Dave Grusin, over executives who do not know music.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Record labels, producers and the business of making albums

blocks.x: How do you like — you’re with Concord now? Is it working out?

Yeah. That’s fine. That’s very good. John Burke is a good guy. He’s a musician also, just like Larry and Dave were. And that makes a big difference as opposed to a music executive that doesn’t know music.
Yeah. I’ve heard that comment a lot of times.
That can be a problem. But I’ve lucked out. And of course I’m very difficult.
You mean you’re difficult to get along with?
